info.name: Kondangyuk API (v1)
info.description:
API documentation for Kondangyuk

Auth: cookie-based. Run **Public | Sessions → Create session (login)** first; Postman stores the httpOnly `session_token` cookie and sends it automatically on subsequent requests. Set `baseUrl`, `email`, and `password` in the environment.

request.description: Authenticates user and sets httpOnly session cookie. Rate limited to 10 requests/minute per IP.
Destroys the current session and clears the session cookie.
Returns the authenticated user profile. Accessible by admin and super_admin.
Returns all users with role admin. Accessible by super_admin only.
Creates a new user with role admin. Accessible by super_admin only.
Returns all themes with pagination. Accessible by super_admin only.
Creates a new theme. Accessible by super_admin only.
Returns a single theme by ID. Accessible by super_admin only.
Updates a theme by ID. Accessible by super_admin only.
Soft deletes a theme by ID (sets deleted_at). Record is retained in the database and excluded from all queries. Accessible by super_admin only.
Lists media attached to an invitation document (proxy URLs). Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Uploads a media file (image/audio/video) to an invitation document and returns its stable proxy URL. Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Permanently deletes (purges) a media attachment by ID — hard delete. Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Lists media attached to a template document (proxy URLs). Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Uploads a media file (image/audio/video) to a template document and returns its stable proxy URL to embed in the document meta DSL. Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Permanently deletes (purges) a media attachment by ID — hard delete. Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Returns the invitation document (meta + MDX snapshot). Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Updates the invitation document (meta + MDX). Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Permanently deletes an invitation document (hard delete). The invitation_documents table has no deleted_at column. Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Returns the invitation thumbnail proxy URL (or null). Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Uploads/replaces the invitation thumbnail (image only). Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Removes (purges) the invitation thumbnail — hard delete. Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Returns the template thumbnail proxy URL (or null). Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Uploads/replaces the template thumbnail (image only). Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Removes (purges) the template thumbnail — hard delete. Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Returns all invitations with pagination. Accessible by admin or super_admin.

item.name: Create invitation (snapshot of the order template)

request.description: Creates an invitation as an immutable snapshot of the order template document (meta + MDX copied into invitation_document). name/description default to the template's when omitted. Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Returns a single invitation by ID or slug. Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Updates invitation metadata by ID or slug. Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Permanently deletes an invitation by ID or slug (hard delete, cascades to its document). Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Returns all orders with pagination. Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Creates an order for a template (status defaults to pending). Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Returns a single order by ID. Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Updates an order (price and/or status) by ID. Accessible by admin or super_admin.
Permanently deletes an order by ID (hard delete). Accessible by admin or super_admin.

Public customer page — returns a published, non-expired invitation by slug together with its document (meta + MDX) and thumbnail URL. No authentication required. Unpublished or expired invitations return 404.

query.description: Filter by theme id (templates having that theme)

request.description: Public template catalog — returns published templates (those with a published_at) with pagination, optionally filtered by theme or tier. No authentication required. Unpublished/draft templates are excluded.
Returns the document (frontmatter meta + raw MDX) for a template, looked up by template ID or slug. Accessible by super_admin only.
Updates the document (meta + MDX) for a template, looked up by template ID or slug. Accessible by super_admin only.
Permanently deletes a template document (hard delete). The template_documents table has no deleted_at column. Accessible by super_admin only.

query.description: Filter by theme id (templates having that theme)

request.description: Returns all templates with pagination. Accessible by super_admin only.

Creates a template together with its document (atomic). The MDX document is stored as-is and rendered by the client. created_by_user is taken from the authenticated user. Accessible by super_admin only.
Returns a single template (metadata only) by ID or slug. The document detail is fetched via /api/v1/templates/{id}/document. Accessible by super_admin only.
Updates template metadata by ID or slug. The document is updated via its own endpoint. Accessible by super_admin only.
Soft deletes a template by ID or slug (sets deleted_at). Record is retained in the database and excluded from all queries. Accessible by super_admin only.
Returns all tiers with pagination. Accessible by super_admin only.
Creates a new tier. Accessible by super_admin only.
Returns a single tier by ID. Accessible by super_admin only.
Updates a tier by ID. Accessible by super_admin only.
Soft deletes a tier by ID (sets deleted_at). Record is retained in the database and excluded from all queries. Accessible by super_admin only.
